a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the deal quietly. Afterwards I'll operate every round with you so you can refill and take your 4. If you also take now, the split is random. Tell me if you see a better plan.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our original plan, and I'm sorry it costs you. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more. Please take 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4.
